visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a dimly lit, warm-toned bedroom. A woman wearing a white turtleneck and a white 'CHANEL' logo beanie leans over a second woman lying in bed under a white duvet. The woman in the beanie has long brown hair and is actively speaking with an expressive, smiling face, while the woman in bed appears sleepy and looks up. (2) The woman in bed pushes the duvet aside and sits up, revealing she is wearing a blue two-piece pajama set with white star patterns. She looks slightly disoriented as the other woman continues to gesture and talk to her. (3) The scene cuts to a well-lit hotel hallway or entryway. The woman who was previously in bed stands centrally in her blue two-piece set and white slippers. She begins a rhythmic dance routine involving coordinated leg kicks, steps, and hand gestures. Behind her is a hotel room door, a suitcase, and a side table with water bottles. The camera remains static throughout the performance.
